claims.text: The Giants elevated Hyatt from the practice squad to the active roster Saturday, Dan Duggan of The Athletic reports.

claims.author: Dan Duggan
claims.text: Edmunds (chest) was placed on injured reserve Saturday, Dan Duggan of The Athletic reports.

claims.author: Zack Rosenblatt
claims.text: The Jets placed Mauigoa (quadriceps) on injured reserve Saturday, Zack Rosenblatt of The Athletic reports.

claims.author: Martin Frank
claims.text: Greenard (ankle) is listed as questionable for Monday night's game against the Cowboys, Martin Frank of The Delaware News Journal reports.

claims.author: Tom Pelissero
claims.text: Hurts (calf) is expected to be held out of football activities for multiple months and miss the rest of the season after new imaging over the weekend revealed several blood clots in his lungs, Tom Pelissero of Netflix reports.

claims.author: Teresa Varley
claims.text: Rudolph is active for Sunday's game against the Saints in Paris, Teresa Varley of the Steelers' official site reports.

claims.author: Teresa Varley
claims.text: Joseph-Day (triceps) was placed on injured reserve by the Steelers on Thursday, Teresa Varley of the team's official website reports.

claims.author: Matt Maiocco
claims.text: Samuel (hamstring) has a chance to return following the 49ers' Week 8 bye, Matt Maiocco of NBC Sports Bay Area reports.

claims.author: David Lombardi
claims.text: 49ers coach Kyle Shanahan reiterated Monday that Robinson (ankle) has a chance to return following the team's Week 8 bye, David Lombardi of SFStandard.com reports.

claims.author: David Lombardi
claims.text: Stribling (ankle) remains on track to return in December, David Lombardi of SFStandard.com reports.

claims.author: David Lombardi
claims.text: Evans (Achilles) is expected to return after San Francisco's Week 8 bye, David Lombardi of SF Standard reports.

claims.author: David Lombardi
claims.text: McCaffrey is dealing with a mild hamstring strain rather than a quadriceps injury, and the 49ers believe he'll be ready following the team's Week 8 bye, David Lombardi of SF Standard reports.

claims.author: Brooke Evans
claims.text: Stout (shoulder) is active for Sunday's game against the Falcons, Brooke Evans of the 49ers' official site reports.

claims.author: Brooke Evans
claims.text: Cooks could be set to work as San Francisco's top wideout Week 7 against Atlanta, as both Mike Evans (Achilles) and Deebo Samuel (hamstring) have been ruled out for the contest, per Brooke Evans of the team's official site.

claims.author: David Lombardi
claims.text: Greenlaw was reinstated by the NFL on Tuesday after he served a one-game suspension in Week 6, David Lombardi of SFStandard.com reports.

claims.author: Ian Rapoport
claims.text: Cross underwent an MRI and was diagnosed with a high ankle sprain, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

claims.author: Gregg Bell
claims.text: Seahawks head coach Mike Macdonald said Monday that Price (chest) will be designated for return from injured reserve during Week 8, Gregg Bell of Sports Radio 93.3 KJR Seattle reports.

claims.author: Curtis Crabtree
claims.text: Lock (elbow) is inactive but serving as the Seahawks' emergency third quarterback for Sunday night's contest against the Chiefs, Curtis Crabtree of Fox 13 Seattle reports.

claims.author: John Boyle
claims.text: The Seahawks activated Bradford (knee) from injured reserve Saturday, and he does not carry an injury designation into Sunday's game against the Chiefs, John Boyle of the Seahawks' official site reports.

claims.author: John Boyle
claims.text: The Seahawks signed Charles off the practice squad to the active roster Saturday, John Boyle of the team's official site reports.

claims.author: John Boyle
claims.text: Holani is slated to remain Seattle's No. 2 running back Sunday against Kansas City, as Zach Charbonnet (knee) has been ruled out for the contest, John Boyle of the team's official site reports.

claims.author: Curtis Crabtree
claims.text: Head coach Mike Macdonald told reporters Friday that Arroyo (shoulder) underwent surgery and will likely be out for the rest of the season, Curtis Crabtree of Fox 13 Seattle reports.

claims.author: Brianna Dix
claims.text: Daniels is expected to work as Tampa Bay's No. 2 QB on Sunday in Carolina, as Baker Mayfield (thumb) is questionable to play but is expected to start, Scott Smith and Brianna Dix of the Buccaneers' official site report.

claims.author: Greg Auman
claims.text: McCollum (illness) does not carry an injury designation into Sunday's game against the Panthers, Greg Auman of Fox Sports reports.

claims.text: Rozeboom (finger) was placed on injured reserve by the Buccaneers on Thursday, Scott Smith of the team's official website reports.

claims.text: Sills (hamstring) was activated from injured reserve by the Buccaneers on Thursday, Scott Smith of the team's official website reports.

claims.author: Terry McCormick
claims.text: Titans head coach Robert Saleh said Monday that Townsend is still being evaluated after sustaining a left knee injury in Sunday's 27-24 loss to the Browns, Terry McCormick of TitanInsider.com reports.

claims.text: The Titans signed Horne from the practice squad to the active roster Saturday, Jim Wyatt of the team's official site reports.

claims.text: The Titans opened Mausi's 21-day practice window Wednesday, Jim Wyatt of the team's official website reports.

claims.author: Nicki Jhabvala
claims.text: Coach Dan Quinn noted Monday that with Terry McLaurin (knee) out for the season, Stefon Diggs' workload isn't expected to change much, however others, notably Williams, should see added opportunities in McLaurin's looming absence, Nicki Jhabvala of The Athletic reports.

claims.author: Nicki Jhabvala
claims.text: Commanders head coach Dan Quinn said Monday that Mariota (knee) is on track to return to practice this week, Nicki Jhabvala of The Athletic reports.

claims.author: Tashan Reed
claims.text: Lane underwent surgery Oct. 9 to repair his fractured and dislocated ankle, and he is expected to be cleared for activities before OTAs, Tashan Reed of The Washington Post reports.

claims.text: Kinlaw (knee) won't return to Washington's matchup versus the 49ers on Monday, John Keim of ESPN reports.
